content: Bu Karriburlume Yawey Nawu God Dja King Duninjh.
Kondah kurorre rowk dja njalehnjale nawu kahdi kurorre, nakka wanjh Yawey nuye. Birriwarlahkenh bininj rowk nawu kabirrihni kubolkbubuyika kore kondah kurorre, nakka wanjh Yawey nuye.
Nungka wanjh bolkmarnbom kunbolk rowk bu kurrmeng kanjdjikah kore kurrula duninjh, dja kore kukku kaboyo bolknameng kanjdji duninjh.
Kaluk nangale bininj namak ba bu kabidbun kore kurrulum nuye Yawey? Nangale bininj kangime kore kubolkdjamun nuye nawu Yawey?
Nakka nawu kunmak kadjalkurduyime dja mak kadjalburrbun kore kunmakkenh, dja mak minj kabimarneboddan nawu idols, dja minj mak kakurren bu kawokkurrmerren.
Namekbe namak bininj wanjh nawu Yawey kabimarnekurduyime kunmak. Kaluk God nawu kabingehke wanjh kabidjalmakwan.
Kuhni kabirrikurduyime birriwern bininj nawu kabirriyawan God. Yoh, birrimekbe bininj kabirridjare ngundikebnan, ngudda God nuye Jacob.
Mah, wanjh. Ngurrina! Ngurridangmarrhma manbu mankare duninjh gates ba kamngimen king nawu namakkaykenh duninjh.
Kaluk nangale nahni nawu namakkaykenh king? Nungka wanjh Yawey nawu narrulkarrekimuk duninjh, dja nawu kabenyurrhke birriwarre bininj kunngudj nuye dorrengh kore kabirriburren.
Mah, wanjh ngurridangmarrhma manbu mankare gates ba kamngimen king nawu namakkaykenh duninjh!
Kaluk nangale nahni nawu namakkaykenh king? Nungka wanjh Yawey nawu wernhdulkarrekimuk duninjh! Nungka nadjalkudji king namakkaykenh duninjh.
